subject: Stakeholder mapping and next steps for Redwood evaluation
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Daniela Ruiz <daniela@novusai.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder mapping and next steps for Redwood evaluation

Hi Daniela — thanks again for the time on today's call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Need: reduce token costs on batch-heavy pipelines, 95th-pct latency SLO for API responses, and private deployment options for PII workloads.
- Key concerns you raised: SOC 2 evidence, procurement timeline, and approval by finance for committed capacity.

Could you confirm the primary economic buyer (person who signs off on spend) and the day-to-day budget owner for this project? That will help me tailor the mutual action plan (attached) and pricing options. I’ve attached a one-page mutual action plan and a short security summary that covers SOC 2 posture and data handling.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Intro call with economic buyer (15–30 min) — I can present a short ROI sketch and commitment options.
2) Share RFP / procurement checklist and SOC 2 artifacts (we can provide the summary and a link to attestations).
3) If budget owner prefers, set up a short technical session with Grace (SE) for runbook/capacity sizing.

Attachments: MAP_NovusAI_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan), Redwood_Security_Summary.pdf

Available times for the buyer intro (PT): Tue 10/5 10:00–10:30, Wed 10/6 14:00–14:30, Fri 10/8 11:00–11:30. I’m flexible if those don’t work.

Thanks — Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0194
From: Daniela Ruiz <daniela@novusai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping and next steps for Redwood evaluation

Camila — great follow-up and good summary. Quick answers: 

- Economic buyer: Marcus Liao (CFO) — he will sign off on any multi-quarter commit. I’ve copied him on the thread below.
- Budget owner / day-to-day approver: Helena Park, VP of Platform (she owns cloud costs and the pilots).
- Procurement contact: procurement@novusai.com (they own contracts and DPA).

Target timeline: we’re aiming for a purchasing decision by the end of Q4 (internal roadmap commitments). Procurement will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a DPA. I’m attaching an internal RFP draft so you can see the scorecard we’ll use.

I can join the intro with Marcus if it helps. Wed 10/6 14:00 PT looks good for Marcus on our side — can you lock that?

Attachment: NovusAI_RFP_Draft.docx

Thanks,
Daniela Ruiz
Director, Infrastructure Programs | NovusAI
daniela@novusai.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Liao <marcus.liao@novusai.com>, Helena Park <helena@novusai.com>, Daniela Ruiz <daniela@novusai.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: short ROI + procurement path for NovusAI pilot (15 min)

Marcus / Helena — thanks for joining the thread. Per Daniela, NovusAI is evaluating solutions to lower token spend and get predictable latency for batch inference and low-latency API traffic. I promised a short, focused intro to align on buying criteria and next steps.

Proposed 15-min agenda:
- 3 min: quick intro + use case summary
- 6 min: ROI sketch (3 variants: hosted POC, dedicated reserved, private deployment)
- 4 min: procurement checklist & timeline (SOC 2, DPA, contract cadence)
- 2 min: confirm next steps / owners

I’ve attached the MAP and the Redwood security summary for Marcus and Helen to review ahead of time. If Wed 10/6 14:00 PT still works for you, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short slide with the ROI numbers.

If Marcus prefers, Grace can join the call to answer technical sizing and latency questions.

Thanks — Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Liao <marcus.liao@novusai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniela Ruiz <daniela@novusai.com>, Helena Park <helena@novusai.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: short ROI + procurement path for NovusAI pilot (15 min)

Camila — thanks. Wed 10/6 at 14:00 PT works for me but I’ll be tight on time. Two quick asks so we make the most of 15 minutes: 

1) Can you include a ballpark to compare: (a) one-month hosted POC with no commit, (b) 6-month reserved capacity, (c) private VPC deployment estimate (OPEX vs. CAPEX notes)? A ballpark cost per 1M tokens per month for our profile would be enough.
2) Procurement will want to see SOC 2 attestations and a draft DPA before legal engages. If you can point to those artifacts in advance, procurement can kick off their review.

I’ll be on the call for the first 15 minutes; if additional time is needed we can schedule a follow-up with Helena and Infrastructure leads.

Marcus Liao
CFO | NovusAI
From: procurement@novusai.com <procurement@novusai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: NovusAI procurement checklist for Redwood

Hi Camila — procurement team here. To move forward we need the following items so we can create a procurement packet for Legal and Finance: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (or security summary + link to attestations)
- Vendor questionnaire responses (we use the attached RFP but please respond inline)
- Draft DPA and Master Services Agreement (we prefer DocuSign-ready templates)
- Standard insurance and indemnity language (limits)
- Pricing options: POC (no commit), reserved monthly capacity (3/6/12 mo), and private deployment SOW outline.

Timeline: once we have the artifacts above, legal will review within 5 business days and procurement can produce a redline for commercial terms within 3 business days after that.

Please send artifacts to procurement@novusai.com. If helpful, we can use a shared Drive folder for uploads.

Procurement Team
NovusAI

Links: HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/NovusAI. Drive upload folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Axyz/NovusAI-eval. DPA/contract flow: https://www.docusign.com/templates/redwood-dpa

- Send calendar invite for Wed 10/6 14:00 PT (15 min) — will include a 1-slide ROI summary.

If procurement needs additional legal contacts for faster routing, please advise and I’ll escalate on our side.

Best — Camila
